2608.14022.title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
2608.14022.paper_summary: Action-conditioned video world models require low-latency causal generation and reliable responses to game-native controls. Although causal distillation enables one- or few-step video synthesis, extending it to interactive world models remains challenging, as discrete keyboard states and continuous mouse motion must remain aligned with temporally compressed latent chunks during causal training and autoregressive rollout. We introduce ForgeWM, a progressive framework that transforms a bidirectional action-conditioned video generator into efficient few-step world models through domain adaptation, teacher-forced causal training, causal consistency distillation, and on-policy distribution matching with a bidirectional teacher. The resulting budget-specialized students operate at steady-state denoising budgets of 1, 2, and 4 steps. ForgeWM further supports a dual-path deployment protocol combining latency-critical interaction with optional replay-time refinement, where the one-step student re-noises and refines its saved draft. On paired Minecraft trajectories, ForgeWM leads the evaluated systems in Imaging Quality, reference-aligned motion-profile agreement, action-sign accuracy, and mouse-control accuracy, while achieving the lowest reference LPIPS; the same four-stage recipe transfers to gamepad-controlled FPS gameplay. Replay-time refinement matches four-step reference quality while remaining roughly three times closer to the experienced trajectory than regeneration from noise. These results demonstrate ForgeWM's effectiveness for controllable few-step video generation.
2608.14022.paper_summary_zh: 行動條件的視頻世界模型需要低延遲的因果生成和對遊戲原生控制的可靠響應。雖然因果蒸餾使得一步或少步視頻合成成為可能，但將其擴展到互動世界模型仍然具有挑戰性，因為離散的鍵盤狀態和連續的鼠標運動必須在因果訓練和自回歸展開過程中與時間壓縮的潛在片段保持對齊。我們介紹了ForgeWM，一個漸進式框架，通過領域適應、教師強制因果訓練、因果一致性蒸餾和與雙向教師的政策分佈匹配，將雙向行動條件視頻生成器轉變為高效的少步世界模型。最終產生的專門預算學生在穩態去噪預算下運行，分別為1、2和4步。ForgeWM進一步支持一種雙路徑部署協議，結合了對延遲敏感的互動和可選的回放時間精煉，其中一步學生重新去噪並精煉其保存的草稿。在配對的Minecraft軌跡上，ForgeWM在成像質量、參考對齊的運動輪廓一致性、行動信號準確性和鼠標控制準確性方面領先於評估系統，同時實現了最低的參考LPIPS；同樣的四階段方案也適用於手柄控制的FPS遊戲。回放時間精煉的質量與四步參考質量相匹配，同時與經驗軌跡的距離大約縮短了三倍，而不是從噪聲中再生。這些結果展示了ForgeWM在可控的少步視頻生成方面的有效性。
